name: sandforge
description: Salesforce Sandbox ETL Toolkit for VSCode

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @sandforge/shared build && pnpm --filter {./packages/extension} build && pnpm --filter @sandforge/webview build && pnpm run copy:webview
scripts.validate: pnpm build:shared && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm audit:disposables && pnpm build
scripts.package: pnpm build && cd packages/extension && npx @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o ../../sandforge.vsix

pnpm.overridesComment: picomatch <4.0.4: ReDoS CVE GHSA-c2c7-rcm5-vvqj (transitive via knip+@vscode/vsce). lodash <4.18.0: code injection CVE GHSA-r5fr-rjxr-66jc (transitive via @vscode/vsce → @secretlint). Both are devDeps that don't ship in the marketplace VSIX, but the dev environment was flagged by `pnpm audit --audit-level high`.
